verses.en: Verily, thus saith the Lord: It shall come to pass that every soul who forsaketh his sins and cometh unto me, and calleth on my name, and obeyeth my voice, and keepeth my commandments, shall see my face and know that I am;
verses.sm: E moni, ua faapea ona fetalai mai le Alii: O le a oo mai, o tagata taitoatasi e lafoai ana agasala ma sau ia te a’u, ma valaau mai i lo’u igoa, ma usiusitai i lo’u leo, ma tausi i a’u poloaiga, o le a vaai i o’u mata ma iloa o i ai a’u;

verses.en: And that I am the true light that lighteth every man that cometh into the world;
verses.sm: Ma o A’u o le malamalama moni ua faamalamalama ai tagata uma e o mai i le lalolagi;

verses.en: And that I am in the Father, and the Father in me, and the Father and I are one—
verses.sm: Ma ua Ou i ai i totonu o le Tamā, ma le Tamā i totonu ia te a’u, ma o le Tamā ma A’u ua tasi—

verses.en: The Father because he gave me of his fulness, and the Son because I was in the world and made flesh my tabernacle, and dwelt among the sons of men.
verses.sm: O le Tamā ona ua ia tuuina mai ia te a’u lona atoatoaga, ma o le Atalii ona sa Ou i ai i le lalolagi ma fai i la le tino lo’u fale apitaga, ma mau ai i totonu o atalii o tagata.

verses.en: I was in the world and received of my Father, and the works of him were plainly manifest.
verses.sm: Sa Ou i ai i le lalolagi ma maua mai lo’u Tamā, ma o ana galuega sa manino ona faaalia mai.

verses.en: And John saw and bore record of the fulness of my glory, and the fulness of John’s record is hereafter to be revealed.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai ma molimau Ioane i le atoatoaga o lo’u mamalu, ma o le a faaalia i se taimi o mulimuli mai le atoatoaga o le talafaamaumau a Ioane.

verses.en: And he bore record, saying: I saw his glory, that he was in the beginning, before the world was;
verses.sm: Ma sa molimau mai o ia, fai mai: Sa ou vaai i lona mamalu, sa i ai o ia i le amataga, ae le’i i ai le lalolagi;

verses.en: Therefore, in the beginning the Word was, for he was the Word, even the messenger of salvation—
verses.sm: O le mea lea, sa i ai i le amataga le Lokou, ona o ia o le Lokou, le avefeau lava lea o le faaolataga—

verses.en: The light and the Redeemer of the world; the Spirit of truth, who came into the world, because the world was made by him, and in him was the life of men and the light of men.
verses.sm: O le malamalama ma le Togiola lea o le lalolagi; o le Agaga o le upumoni, o lē na afio mai i le lalolagi, ona o le lalolagi na faia e ia, ma sa i totonu ia te ia le ola o tagata ma le malamalama o tagata.

verses.en: The worlds were made by him; men were made by him; all things were made by him, and through him, and of him.
verses.sm: O ia na faia lalolagi; o ia na faia tagata; o ia na faia mea uma, ma ala mai ia te ia, ma mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And I, John, bear record that I beheld his glory, as the glory of the Only Begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth, even the Spirit of truth, which came and dwelt in the flesh, and dwelt among us.
verses.sm: Ma o a’u, o Ioane, ou te molimau sa ou vaai i lona mamalu, o le mamalu lea o le Toatasi na Fanaua e le Tamā, ua tumu i le alofa tunoa ma le upumoni, le Agaga lava lea o le upumoni, lea na afio mai ma mau i la le tino, ma mau i totonu o i tatou.

verses.en: And I, John, saw that he received not of the fulness at the first, but received grace for grace;
verses.sm: Ma o a’u, o Ioane, sa ou vaai, sa le’i maua e ia le atoatoaga i le amataga, ae sa maua e ia le alofa tunoa mo le alofa tunoa;

verses.en: And he received not of the fulness at first, but continued from grace to grace, until he received a fulness;
verses.sm: Ma sa le’i maua e ia le atoatoaga i le amataga, ae sa faaauau pea mai lea alofa tunoa i lea alofa tunoa, seia oo ina maua e ia le atoatoaga;

verses.en: And thus he was called the Son of God, because he received not of the fulness at the first.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ta’ua ai o ia o le Atalii o le Atua, ona sa le’i maua e ia le atoatoaga i le amataga.

verses.en: And I, John, bear record, and lo, the heavens were opened, and the Holy Ghost descended upon him in the form of a dove, and sat upon him, and there came a voice out of heaven saying: This is my beloved Son.
verses.sm: Ma o a’u, o Ioane, ou te molimau atu, ma faauta, sa avanoa le lagi, ma sa afio ifo le Agaga Paia i ona luga e peiseai o se lupe, ma afio i ona luga, ma sa oo mai se siufofoga mai le lagi ua fetalai mai: O lo’u Atalii pele lenei.

verses.en: And I, John, bear record that he received a fulness of the glory of the Father;
verses.sm: Ma o a’u, o Ioane, ou te molimau atu, sa maua e ia se atoatoaga o le mamalu o le Tamā;

verses.en: And he received all power, both in heaven and on earth, and the glory of the Father was with him, for he dwelt in him.
verses.sm: Ma sa maua e ia le mana uma, i le lagi ma i le lalolagi, ma sa faatasi ma ia le mamalu o le Tamā, ona sa afio o ia i totonu o ia.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that if you are faithful you shall receive the fulness of the record of John.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, afai tou te faamaoni, o le a outou maua le atoatoaga o le talafaamaumau a Ioane.

verses.en: I give unto you these sayings that you may understand and know how to worship, and know what you worship, that you may come unto the Father in my name, and in due time receive of his fulness.
verses.sm: Ou te tuu atu ia te outou nei upu, ina ia outou malamalama ma iloa ai le ala e tapuai ai, ma iloa ai le mea tou te tapuai i ai, ina ia mafai ona outou o mai i le Tamā i lo’u igoa, ma maua lona atoatoaga i le taimi e tatau ai.

w.en: of the Father in my name

verses.en: For if you keep my commandments you shall receive of his fulness, and be glorified in me as I am in the Father; therefore, I say unto you, you shall receive grace for grace.
verses.sm: Aua afai tou te tausi i a’u poloaiga, o le a outou maua lona atoatoaga, ma faamamaluina ia te a’u e pei o a’u i le Tamā; o lea, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a outou maua le alofa tunoa mo le alofa tunoa.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you, I was in the beginning with the Father, and am the Firstborn;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, sa Ou i ai i le amataga faatasi ma le Tamā, ma o A’u o le Ulumatua na Fanaua;

verses.en: And all those who are begotten through me are partakers of the glory of the same, and are the church of the Firstborn.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou uma o e e fananauina e ala mai ia te a’u ua faatofutofusia i le mamalu o lea lava e tasi, ma o le ekalesia a le Ulumatua na Fanaua.

verses.en: Ye were also in the beginning with the Father; that which is Spirit, even the Spirit of truth;
verses.sm: Sa outou i ai foi i le amataga faatasi ma le Tamā; o lena o le Agaga, o le Agaga lava lea o le upumoni;

verses.en: And truth is knowledge of things as they are, and as they were, and as they are to come;
verses.sm: Ma o le upumoni o le iloa lea o mea e pei ona i ai, ma e pei ona sa i ai, ma e pei ona o le a oo mai;

verses.en: And whatsoever is more or less than this is the spirit of that wicked one who was a liar from the beginning.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se mea lava e tele atu pe itiiti ifo nai lo lenei, o le agaga lea o lena amioleaga e toatasi, o lē o se pepelo mai le amataga.

verses.en: The Spirit of truth is of God. I am the Spirit of truth, and John bore record of me, saying: He received a fulness of truth, yea, even of all truth;
verses.sm: O le Agaga o le upumoni ua mai le Atua. O A’u o le Agaga o le upumoni, ma sa molimau Ioane e uiga ia te a’u, fai mai: Sa maua e ia se atoatoaga o le upumoni, ioe, upumoni uma lava;

verses.en: And no man receiveth a fulness unless he keepeth his commandments.
verses.sm: Ma e leai se tagata na te mauaina se atoatoaga vagana ai ua tausi e ia ana poloaiga.

verses.en: He that keepeth his commandments receiveth truth and light, until he is glorified in truth and knoweth all things.
verses.sm: O ia o lē e tausia ana poloaiga, e maua e ia le upumoni ma le malamalama, seia oo ina faamamaluina o ia i le upumoni ma iloa e ia mea uma.

verses.en: Man was also in the beginning with God. Intelligence, or the light of truth, was not created or made, neither indeed can be.
verses.sm: Sa i ai foi le tagata i le amataga faatasi ma le Atua. O le atamai, po o le malamalama o le upumoni, sa le’i foafoaina pe na gaosia, pe mafai moni lava ona foafoaina pe gaosia.

verses.en: All truth is independent in that sphere in which God has placed it, to act for itself, as all intelligence also; otherwise there is no existence.
verses.sm: O upumoni uma lava ua tu lē faalagolago i le tulaga ua tuu i ai e le Atua, e gaoioi mo ia lava, e pei foi o atamai uma; a na lē faapea, ua leai se olaga.

verses.en: Behold, here is the agency of man, and here is the condemnation of man; because that which was from the beginning is plainly manifest unto them, and they receive not the light.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le faitalia lenei a le tagata, ma o le ta’usalaga lenei o le tagata; ona ua manino ona faaali atu ia te i latou o lena mea sa i ai mai le amataga, ae ua latou lē taliaina le malamalama.

verses.en: And every man whose spirit receiveth not the light is under condemnation.
verses.sm: Ma o tagata uma o e e lē talia e o latou agaga le malamalama, ua saisaitia e le ta’usalaga.

verses.en: For man is spirit. The elements are eternal, and spirit and element, inseparably connected, receive a fulness of joy;
verses.sm: Auā o le tagata o le agaga. O elemene ua faavavau, ma o le agaga ma le elemene, ua soofaatasi e lē matuu’eseeseina, e mauaina se atoatoaga o le olioli;

verses.en: And when separated, man cannot receive a fulness of joy.
verses.sm: Ma a tuu’eseese, e lē mafai e le tagata ona maua se atoatoaga o le olioli.

verses.en: The elements are the tabernacle of God; yea, man is the tabernacle of God, even temples; and whatsoever temple is defiled, God shall destroy that temple.
verses.sm: O elemene o fale apitaga a le Atua; ioe, o le tagata o le fale apitaga o le Atua, o ni malumalu lava; ma o soo se malumalu e faaleagaina, o lena malumalu o le a faaumatiaina e le Atua.

verses.en: The glory of God is intelligence, or, in other words, light and truth.
verses.sm: O le mamalu o le Atua o le atamai lea, pe faapea, o le malamalama ma le upumoni.

verses.en: Light and truth forsake that evil one.
verses.sm: O le malamalama ma le upumoni e lafoa’i i lena toatasi leaga.

verses.en: Every spirit of man was innocent in the beginning; and God having redeemed man from the fall, men became again, in their infant state, innocent before God.
verses.sm: O agaga uma o tagata sa mamā i le amataga; ma ona ua togiolaina e le Atua le tagata mai le pa’ū, o lea na toe mamā ai tagata, i lo latou tulaga tamameamea, i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: And that wicked one cometh and taketh away light and truth, through disobedience, from the children of men, and because of the tradition of their fathers.
verses.sm: Ma ona sau lea o le amioleaga e toatasi lena, ma aveese mai le fanauga a tagata le malamalama ma le upumoni, e ala i le lē usiusitai, ma ona o le uputuu a o latou tamā.

verses.en: But I have commanded you to bring up your children in light and truth.
verses.sm: Ae ua Ou poloaiina outou ia tausi a’e a outou fanau i le malamalama ma le upumoni.

verses.en: But verily I say unto you, my servant Frederick G. Williams, you have continued under this condemnation;
verses.sm: Peitai e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, la’u auauna, o Frederick G. Williams, ua e i ai pea i lalo o lenei tausalaga;

verses.en: You have not taught your children light and truth, according to the commandments; and that wicked one hath power, as yet, over you, and this is the cause of your affliction.
verses.sm: E te le’i a’oa’o atua lau fanau i le malamalama ma le upumoni, e tusa ma poloaiga; ma ua i ai pea i lena amioleaga e toatasi le mana, i luga o oe, ma o le pogai lea o lou puapuagatia.

verses.en: And now a commandment I give unto you—if you will be delivered you shall set in order your own house, for there are many things that are not right in your house.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te tuu atu ia te oe se poloaiga— afai e te manao ia laveaiina oe, ia e faatulaga tatau lou lava fale, ona e tele mea ua lē sa’o i lou fale.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto my servant Sidney Rigdon, that in some things he hath not kept the commandments concerning his children; therefore, first set in order thy house.
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu i la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone, e i ai ni isi mea e lei tausia ai e ia poloaiga e faatatau i lana fanau; o lea, ia muamua ona faatulaga tatau lou fale.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., or in other words, I will call you friends, for you are my friends, and ye shall have an inheritance with me—
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, po o i ni isi upu, o le a Ou ta’ua outou o ni uo, ona o outou o a’u uo, ma o le a outou maua se tofi faatasi ma a’u—

verses.en: I called you servants for the world’s sake, and ye are their servants for my sake—
verses.sm: Sa Ou ta’ua outou o auauna ona o le lalolagi, ma o outou o a latou auauna mo a’u—

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto Joseph Smith, Jun.—You have not kept the commandments, and must needs stand rebuked before the Lord;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti— E te le’i tausia poloaiga, ma ua ao ai ona e tulai a’oa’iina i luma o le Alii;

verses.en: Your family must needs repent and forsake some things, and give more earnest heed unto your sayings, or be removed out of their place.
verses.sm: E ao ina salamo lou aiga ma lafoai ni isi o mea, ma gauai atili mai ma le filiga i a’u upu, po o le a aveesea i latou mai lo latou tulaga.

verses.en: What I say unto one I say unto all; pray always lest that wicked one have power in you, and remove you out of your place.
verses.sm: O le mea Ou te fai atu ai i le toatasi Ou te fai atu ai i tagata uma; ia tatalo e lē aunoa ne’i maua e le leaga e toatasi lena le mana i totonu o outou, ma aveese outou i fafo mai lo outou tulaga.

verses.en: My servant Newel K. Whitney also, a bishop of my church, hath need to be chastened, and set in order his family, and see that they are more diligent and concerned at home, and pray always, or they shall be removed out of their place.
verses.sm: O la’u auauna foi o Newel K. Whitney, o se epikopo o la’u ekalesia, ua manaomia foi ona a’oa’iina, ma faatulaga tatau lona aiga, ma vaai ia latou filiga atili ma popole i le aiga, ma tatalo e lē aunoa, po o le a aveesea i latou mai lo latou tulaga.

verses.en: Now, I say unto you, my friends, let my servant Sidney Rigdon go on his journey, and make haste, and also proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the gospel of salvation, as I shall give him utterance; and by your prayer of faith with one consent I will uphold him.
verses.sm: O lenei, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a’u uo, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone e alu lana malaga, ma ia faia faavave, ma tala’i atu foi le tausaga talileleia o le Alii, ma le talalelei o le faaolataga, e pei o le a Ou tuu atu ai ia te ia le manavaga; ma o le a Ou lagolagoina o ia e ala i la outou tatalo i le faatuatua ma le autasi.

verses.en: And let my servants Joseph Smith, Jun., and Frederick G. Williams make haste also, and it shall be given them even according to the prayer of faith; and inasmuch as you keep my sayings you shall not be confounded in this world, nor in the world to come.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Frederick G. Williams, e fai faavave atu foi, ma o le a tuu atu ia te i la’ua e tusa lava ma le tatalo o le faatuatua; ma e tusa ai ma lo outou tausia o a’u upu o le a lē mafai ona faafememea’iina outou i le lalolagi lenei, po o le lalolagi a sau.

verses.en: And, verily I say unto you, that it is my will that you should hasten to translate my scriptures, and to obtain a knowledge of history, and of countries, and of kingdoms, of laws of God and man, and all this for the salvation of Zion. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o lo’u loto ia faataalise ona outou faaliliu o a’u tusitusiga paia, ma maua se malamalama o talafaasolopito, ma atunuu, ma malo, o tulafono a le Atua ma tagata, ma nei mea uma mo le faaolataga o Siona. Amene.
